svg.title: Dragon Database — Ironbound Archive Mobile Concept
svg.desc: A charcoal mobile shell and layered pale-silver hero retain the unchanged Swordslapper Classic underline logo. Dark DragonSlapper display copy sits beside a silver-framed dragon crest, followed by a full-width public Browse Dragons action and Lore link. Two readable raised silver dragon type cards fit within the mobile frame.
svg.metadata: Landing page hero design concept. Illustrative copy and dragon type cards. Selected v8 Swordslapper Classic underline logo reused unchanged. DragonSlapper display lettering and Alegreya Sans body/control text. Alegreya Sans licenses are in logos/v7/fonts. DragonSlapper by Allison James (NAL), copyright 2013, via https://www.fontstruct.com/fontstructions/show/830154/dragonslapper; CC BY-SA 3.0 https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Original font file unchanged; the outlined glyphs included here remain under CC BY-SA 3.0. Not an implemented application.

g.title: Dragon Database — Swordslapper Classic
g.desc: The selected Swordmaw Hybrid dragon, wings, DB monogram and crossed swords with a new DragonSlapper Dragon Database wordmark. Both words align to the full width of the original horizontal sword beneath the lettering. Black on silver.
g.metadata: Logo concept. Original v7 Swordmaw Hybrid dragon and crossed swords reused with unchanged artwork. DragonSlapper by Allison James (NAL), copyright 2013, via https://www.fontstruct.com/fontstructions/show/830154/dragonslapper; CC BY-SA 3.0 https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Original font file unchanged; the outlined glyphs included here remain under CC BY-SA 3.0. Source lettering and its graphic adaptations retain CC BY-SA 3.0 licensing. Application code and adopted brand assets have not been changed.
